description: Gate 2 (bean de0o): toroidal-Legendre (Heine) expansion of the two-strand coaxial-ring Reeb kernel. VERDICT: PARTIAL, scope-(a). Shape+order of the deformation term (q0-1)^2/q0 derived from the radial identification r1/r2 = q0 alone (q-dependence enters only through chi = cosh(ln q0) + d^2/2); exact coefficient/placement 1/sqrt(5+Delta) requires the assumed d^2 = r1*r2 and the exchange-point (psi=pi) amplitude reading, jointly equivalent to the #3436 residual CWF postulate. NEGATIVE: the m=1 mutual-helicity mode Q_{1/2}(chi)/pi does not produce g.
assumed_not_derived: A1: strand radial ratio r1/r2 = q0 (bar-conjugate pair v, 1/v)
A2: axial separation d^2 = r1*r2 (maps to the derived pp-nn asymmetry 1 via the #3436 I2 dictionary, but is un-derived within the toroidal picture)
A3: magnitude = exchange-point (antipodal) kernel amplitude (equivalent to the #3436 CWF unit-tangent postulate: chord direction (r1+r2, d) = ([2]_v, 1) has tan = z, sin = g)
